gates.text: Own the program, not its code.
Reuse its existing responsible coordinator; never create a competing dispatcher or resume held work.
Frame a countable done predicate, unit count, rough effort, tracks, expected stacks, and wall-clock budget.

If one agent could finish within that budget, collapse to [autonomous-run](#autonomous-run) immediately: work in the current session with plain scoped workers only where useful, inline verification where independence is not required, and no program ledger or pilot ceremony.
The collapse rule does not depend on another document being available.
A contested decomposition or one-way door uses [arena](workflows.md#arena) before the pilot.
For a real program the coordinator writes no implementation code.
Code changes, conflict resolution, and chain rebases are delegated units.
Clean integration of an already verified commit may be authorized bookkeeping, never permission to repair code.
Use native `pstack_route` plus emitted `sessions_spawn` arguments for workers, and collect through accepted native tools.
Missing required independent phases are BLOCKED, never silently absorbed as parent implementation.
Prefer isolated authorized remote workers when needed and available; a local child is not a cloud machine.
Keep one task-owned durable program directory, not a new service or live plugin store.
Native file tools replace the source-only orchestration helper.
Give every artifact one writer.

Maintain `preferences.md` numbered standing orders, append-only `overview.md`, `units.tsv` with id/track/state/branch/PR/head/brief, computed `frontier.json`, `ledger.tsv`, completion pointers in `inbox/`, human gates in `gates.md`, a [show-me-your-work](workflows.md#show-me-your-work) trail, and `status.md` derived from tables at each drain.
Without durable artifact access, program custody is BLOCKED.
Never execute upstream orchestration scripts.
Write standing orders before the first spawn.

Every spawn and authorized continuation carries them verbatim plus goal, exclusive write scope and forbidden paths, exact source and dependency reports, checkable acceptance, verification commands or control driver, timebox, prohibitions, and report shape.
Missing fields mean refuse-to-spawn.
A cheap one-command unit may collapse the template but keeps goal, scope, command, and report.
Relay upstream context, not just ordering.
Fresh replacements get consolidated directives and prior evidence; never interrupt-chain a stale brief or replay cancelled inputs.
Existing native owner/incarnation policy governs continuations.
Pilot one unit through brief, work, verification, integration, ledger, and authorized delivery before scaling.
Fix the contract from evidence.
For cheap near-identical units, the first ordinary unit is the pilot and has inline checks; expensive, novel, or high-blast-radius units need an independent different-family verifier.
Sub-coordinators exist only when one coordinator cannot drain the track.
Keep nesting and concurrency within native limits and use a rolling window rather than blocking batches.
Audit one sampled brief per track per wave alongside work; a failed brief stops its next refill and repairs the track instructions.
Treat completions as queued pointers, not interruptions or inline diff reviews.
Drain after critical sections, track rollups, an authorized frontier event, and before reporting.
Snapshot the pending batch; later arrivals wait.
Classify each result as landed, needs-verify, failed, zombie, or noise, update units and ledger, derive status, recompute ready work, then refill.
Account for every child as arrived, replaced, abandoned, or explicitly absorbed with its coverage gap recorded.
Do not silently redo missing work.
Review is a separate scoped unit when needed.
Keep exactly one topology writer per stack in the standing orders.
Workers never rebase, retarget, merge, or close PRs.
Babysitters use one immutable frontier generation and report conflicts to that writer.
Recompute the ordered PRs, branches, exact head SHAs, generation, and lowest unmerged PR after every merge or stack mutation from real forge data; missing PRs are errors, not guessed order.
Integrate continuously from the first verified unit, keep the frontier green, and stop new dispatch around 70 percent of the budget to deliver verified work.
Publication is still separately gated by [shipping](#shipping).
A retro watcher exists only through an explicitly authorized native owner/watch lifecycle.
Key verification ledger rows by PR and exact head SHA with `live-ui-verified`, `unit-test-verified`, `type-check-only`, `verifier-blocked`, or `verifier-failed`.
Cheap deterministic checks may be worker-run with receipt spot-checks; judgment-heavy, expensive, or high-blast-radius checks need an independent different-family verifier.
CI is an input, not a verdict.
Behavioral work needs more than type-check-only, blocked never passes, failures produce fix units, and a new head invalidates its row until reverified.
Externalize branches, receipts, and verdicts promptly through authorized storage or publication, not at the end.
Probe liveness read-only from actual side effects and native status, never resume merely to check.

Retry cap-hit or OOM with smaller scope, network loss with the same scope, tool error with an available explicitly routed alternative, unknown failure once; at most two retries, then abandon and replan.
Reconcile late results against current frontier and ledger before salvaging unique findings.
Tree-wide bad acceptance or dead infrastructure stops refills while its cause is fixed.
Bound coordinator tool retries too and leave a durable exact-resume handoff on repeated failure.
On restart reconcile real native child state, standing orders, units, frontier, branches, and receipts before continuation; do not assume a remote worker died or resurrect a cancelled child.
Route around human gates recorded with decision, options, and recommendation.
Fix only discoveries blocking the frontier; park unrelated follow-ups.

At close reconcile every spawn to a terminal state, verify the predicate and each landed exact-head verdict, audit the trail against scoped native history, and resolve its mandatory different-family reviewer through `pstack_route` and native `sessions_spawn`.
Missing history or independent review is a BLOCKED close gate.
Encode recurring corrections in the standing orders or brief template and preserve the program record.
**Reply.** Table-derived predicate count, track deliveries, frontier PRs and SHAs, verdict summary, abandoned units and reasons, human gates, program directory, and trail path.
A drain status gives counts, changes, and open gates; routine notifications stay with the owning session, not Main.

11. When the `pstack_brief` check rejects a delegate's report, for example over a `contractRead` entry that names a section such as `workflows.md#orchestrate` instead of the exact path, rerun the delegate once as a fresh `sessions_spawn` child from the same plan, with the check's exact error and the exact required paths in its task. A collector child refuses a same-owner correction, so that refusal never ends the unit; only a second rejection marks it failed in the ledger.
